page.overview:
What is Sfatlicllp?

Sfatlicllp is the daughter of Zvilpogghua. She is the wife of a Voormi and their offspring is Knygathin Zhaum.

Sfatlicllp was likely born on Kythanil and may have procreated the Formless Spawn once on Earth and probably became their leader (or co-leader). She probably dwells in N'kai with Tsathoggua. Possibly she became the "wife" of Nyogtha, who dwells in Yoth.
